caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-handled tool with a vertical orientation, likely a hand-crank device. The handle is cylindrical, horizontally aligned, and has curved grooves for grip; it is attached to the top right of the device. The main body is teardrop-shaped and colored in rich brown wood tones, with visible wood grain texture and shadows accentuating its rounded form. A metallic, semicircular plate featuring two flathead screws is fixed at the base, and an elongated cutout runs vertically along the front center, revealing a lighter inner track and part of the internal mechanism. The entire object is presented on a plain, light-brownish background, and there is a small, neat signature reading "Carl Burger..." near the bottom, slightly to the right.
title: Police Rattle
